item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 07/Jul/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring generally fine and persistently very hot weather to southern China in the next couple of days. The anticyclone aloft is expected to weaken slightly early to midweek next week, there will be more showers over the northern part of the South China Sea.

Date/Month: 08/07 (Saturday)
Wind: Southwest force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly fine apart from isolated showers. Very hot during the day.
Temp range: 28 - 33 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
